summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ does a prefix test via self.startswith(ref), and ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only when ref equals a stored term URI using node-type-aware equality (inherited by _RDFNamespace). Added tests in test/test_namespace.py covering Namespace prefix membership, RDFS positive/negative and non-URIRef negatives, and RDF positive. Tests were not run because the task forbade running repository code; no commits made. Not added: SH membership test and the container-property (_1) assertion.
